title: Smooth-stage factorization with independent carrier universes
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $A$ a finitely presented commutative $R$-algebra, $L$ a commutative $R$-algebra, and $f:A\to L$ an $R$-algebra map. Suppose $L$ is a filtered colimit of smooth $R$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-smooth-algebras], with stages and small filtered index in the joint universe of $R,A,L$. Then there exist a commutative $R$-algebra $B$ in that joint universe, smooth over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], and $R$-algebra maps $\beta:A\to B$ and $\delta:B\to L$ with $\delta\beta=f$. The carrier universes of $R$ and $A$ may be strictly smaller than that of $L$.

proof.text: Lift R to R′=ULift R in the target universe. Construct the equivalence CommAlgCat R ≌ Under(CommRingCat.of R′) explicitly: the forward map uses the structure map composed with ULift.down, and the inverse uses ULift.up. Their composites are naturally isomorphic to identity by the identity ring equivalence. Filtered categories are connected, so the underlying-ring forgetful functor preserves the given colimit.

Lift A to A′ in the target universe. R′→R is an algebra equivalence, so finite presentation of A/R gives finite presentation of A′/R′ by composition and equivalence. Apply RingHom.EssFiniteType.exists_eq_comp_ι_app_of_isColimit to the ring colimit with the compatible R′ structure maps. This gives a stage and a map g′ from A′ with the required composite equality.

The structure-map equality at ULift.up r makes g′ an R-algebra map. Compose g′ with ULift.up on A and take the coprojection as the target map. Evaluate the factorization equality on ULift.up a to prove the algebra-homomorphism composite equality. The stage is smooth by the ind-smooth presentation.
